'''Jempa''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] living in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Toola/Legends|Toola]], Jempa was part of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Bear Clan/Legends|Bear Clan]]. As was common among young Whiphids, he had very little fur. He carried a green [[Training lightsaber/Legends|training lightsaber]].
